name: s1-web-templates
title: S1 web template gallery, live page preview and clone
description: Four self-built single-file web templates (portfolio, SaaS landing, event signup, documentation site) served through the existing immutable template store, a gallery whose covers render the real page scaled from 1280x800, hover peek with in-page auto scroll, a desktop/phone preview dialog with real interaction, and clone into an independent project version.
creator: admin
notes: Templates are a real running starting point, not a generated result. The single-file web generation pipeline landed afterwards in 11-18-s1-web-generation; multi-file projects, structured file operations and build/browser smoke are still not implemented. R20 todo/kanban web templates remain open.
